messages.content: Are you between 18 and 65 years old?
Yes, I’m 31, so I’m within that age range.
What is your current height and weight? Please include units—for example, 170 cm and 68 kg, or 5 ft 7 in and 150 lb. If you do not know, say so.
I’m 170 cm tall and weigh 68 kg.
Are you currently receiving medication-based or psychological treatment for a sleep disorder?
No, I’m not currently receiving medication-based or psychological treatment for a sleep disorder.
Are you willing to follow the study procedures?
Yes, I’m willing to follow all the study procedures.
My schedule rotates, and I sometimes work overnight, though I can’t say how often.
Are overnight shifts a regular part of your work schedule, or do they happen only occasionally?
I’m not sure whether they count as regular or only occasional—my schedule rotates, and I can’t say how often I work overnight.
Does your rotating schedule include any shifts that run overnight?
Yes, my rotating schedule does include overnight shifts, though I can’t say how often.
No, I don’t use recreational drugs.
No, I’m neither pregnant nor breastfeeding.
Thanks, Nina. Your answers are with the study team. A coordinator will review them and reach out within 2 business days.
